{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after cleaning
print(f'Rows after dropping missing values: {len(df_clean)}')

# Compute Pearson correlation
corr = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])
print(f'Pearson correlation: {corr}')"}
